raw_definitions: Definisi : vt give secondary title to, memberi [sst] tajuk kecil: Hardy ~d “Tess of the d’Urbervilles” – “A Pure Woman”, Hardy memberi “Tess of the d’Urbervilles”, tajuk kecil “A Pure Woman”. (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : n 1. translation of a film script printed on the film, sari kata: an English film with Malay ~s, filem Inggeris dgn sari kata dlm bahasa Melayu; 2. secondary title (of a book) tajuk kecil; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
